race.title: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: LANZHOU has been going the right way since switched to handicaps, gaining a first success over hurdles last month before awarded the race on chasing debut, and he can continue his progress as he returns to hurdling. Theanniversary Man isn't taken lightly under a penalty, though, while River Vale could go well with his recent run behind him. LANZHOU (FR) THEANNIVERSARY MAN (IRE) RIVER VALE (IRE)
